patches.name: @cordisjs/plugin-cli-cordis
patches.description: Stable root include id, launcher include overrides, IPC health pings and a ready message

patches.name: @cordisjs/plugin-database
patches.description: Prepare tables extended while the driver was still starting; also installed as minato

patches.name: @cordisjs/plugin-http
patches.description: Use resolveIntercept, which Cordis 4 renamed from resolveConfig; merge request headers per name and send the global FormData as multipart

patches.name: @cordisjs/plugin-loader
patches.description: Load prelude entries first and plugins one at a time

patches.name: @cordisjs/plugin-server
patches.description: Use resolveIntercept, which Cordis 4 renamed from resolveConfig

patches.name: @cordisjs/unyaml
patches.description: Register the Vite YAML plugin through rolldownOptions instead of the retired esbuildOptions

patches.name: @koishijs/core
patches.description: Run Koishi on Cordis 4; also installed as koishi. Inject shapes are normalized by the @satorijs/core patch

patches.name: @satorijs/core
patches.description: Run Satori and its adapters on Cordis 4: { required, optional } inject, ready/dispose events, Koishi 4 service lookups, a Quester-compatible http and a Koa-style server for adapter fibers

patches.name: @satorijs/adapter-discord
patches.description: Keep literal markup in message text, decode rich embeds as elements and resolve the author of a DM delete

patches.name: @satorijs/adapter-qq
patches.description: Decode official QQ group_openid targets, ARK cards, nested chat records and index-only quotes; keep absolute channel image URLs and literal markup in guild text

patches.name: @satorijs/adapter-telegram
patches.description: Mention the bot by username, decode contacts, polls, dice, venues and video notes, scope albums and forum topics to their chat, and omit missing ids from uploads

patches.name: koishi-plugin-adapter-onebot
patches.description: Import Satori directly and inject http, satori and timer; mark friend_recall as a direct channel like private messages
